sessions.prompt:
Add parse_plate(s) to tickets.py: a licence plate string is returned in upper case with spaces removed (" ab 123 " becomes "AB123"). Add tests.

The plan for parse_plate has one more step: hyphens are removed too, and a plate that is then not 2 to 8 letters and digits raises ValueError ("ab-12 3" becomes "AB123"; "a" and "ab!12" raise). Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a stay cannot end before it starts: any function given an exit time earlier than the entry time raises ValueError and changes nothing.

Design decision for this project: the first 15 minutes of a stay are free.
